SecuritiesSettlementTransactionIdentific.name: Securities Settlement Transaction Identification
SecuritiesSettlementTransactionIdentific.definition: Unambiguous identification of a securities settlement transaction as known by the account owner (or instructing party acting on its behalf).

IntraPositionMovementIdentification.name: Intra Position Movement Identification
IntraPositionMovementIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the intra-position movement transaction as known by the account owner (or instructing party acting on its behalf).

IntraBalanceMovementIdentification.name: Intra Balance Movement Identification
IntraBalanceMovementIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the intra balance movement transaction as known by the account owner.

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

CounterpartyMarketInfrastructureTransact.name: Counterparty Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
CounterpartyMarketInfrastructureTransact.definition: Identification of a counterparty transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

OtherTransactionIdentification.name: Other Transaction Identification
OtherTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of a transaction that cannot be identified using a standard reference element present in the message.
